title: Better Off — the debut record, where it started
hook: Everybody's got a first record. This one's mine.
body:
Better Off was the debut — the songs I had to get out before I could write anything else. Rough around the edges in the best way. Still proud of every one of them.

Start there if you want to hear where this all began.
